title: Clerk button
description: Small, precise app-style buttons: a graphite gradient button with an inner top highlight and an optional play caret, a white hairline button with a soft lift, and a violet primary.
notes: the solid style is foreground-coloured: graphite on light themes, white on dark ones
name: clerk-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: graphite gradient · outline: white with a hairline and soft shadow · primary: brand violet

props.name: icon
props.description: small icon before the label (e.g. a provider mark)

props.name: caret
props.description: small play-style caret after the label
